items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: Played with Buddy Petit. We played with Buddy Petit a solid two weeks in Mandeville.

ctx.x: Yeah. I was going to ask about Buddy Petit. Buddy.

items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: Great trumpet player. That's right. Yeah. He was a great little trumpet player, Buddy Petit world.

ctx.x: Everybody says he was great. I never got to hear him now.
Great trumpet player. That's right. Yeah. He was a great little trumpet player, Buddy Petit world.
Do you remember the place you played? What kind of a certain dance hall or club or something?

items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: This fella, Burybank. Sometime he'd have Burybank with him. Play clarinet.

ctx.x: Remember who the clarinet player was?
Yeah, no. The clarinet player, and I... Let's see. Sometime he'd have... This fella, Burybank. Sometime he'd have Burybank with him. Play clarinet.
Punch said he used to play some of the Georgia Boy. Georgia Boy. Did you see in the band?
